sar.narrative: On December 1, 2016, a transaction (ID: 3503878) for $99.92 was attempted using card C07987-K2. The transaction was flagged by the bank's real-time risk model with a score of 0.90, indicating a very high probability of fraud. Investigation of the transaction metadata revealed a discrepancy between the purchaser's email domain (verizon.net) and the recipient's email domain (gmail.com). This pattern is highly indicative of unauthorized card-not-present activity where a third party uses stolen credentials to ship goods to a different digital identity. The transaction was conducted via an online channel. Based on the high probability of fraud and the suspicious nature of the email mismatch, this report is filed to document potential fraudulent activity.

stop_reason: High risk score and clear fraud indicators met threshold for immediate closure.
